description.county_id: county FIPS code, 5 characters (claims: countyCode; policies: first 5 characters of censusGeoid)
description.zone: flood zone group from ratedFloodZone: V* (coastal, waves), A* (100-year floodplain), X (moderate or low risk). V* and A* form the SFHA
description.year: calendar year (claims: yearOfLoss; policies: days covered in the year)
description.n_claims: claims with a positive building paid amount (real USD > 0)
description.exposure_years: policy-years in force: sum of policyCount x days covered / 365.25
description.mean_coverage: building coverage-years / policy-years, nominal USD (rises with prices, so it carries a time trend: prefer coverage_real in models)
description.coverage_real: mean_coverage in constant 2024 USD, deflated by the annual average CPI-U of the previous year
description.hist_claims_1990_2008: paid claims of this county and zone, loss years 1990-2008
description.hist_per_1000: hist_claims_1990_2008 per 1,000 average policy-years of the county and zone over 2010-2019
description.county_hist_per_1000: paid claims of the county (all zones), 1990-2008, per 1,000 average yearly policy-years of the county over 2010-2019
description.n_all: all claims, paid or not (sensitivity count)
description.n_major: paid claims from the 10 largest named events of 2010-2024
description.partial_year: exposure year flagged partial in zone_year (none in 2010-2024)
description.n_policy_rows: number of policy records (not a policy count)
